name: codex-research-harness
description: Maintain a lightweight, recoverable project control plane for a single research project.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight project controls for research work.
interface.longDescription: Keeps one research project's definitions, constraints, state, evidence relationships, task boundaries, file changes, and cross-session recovery current while routing detailed domain procedures to on-demand skills.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the lightweight control plane for this research project.
Apply current project constraints and reconcile affected evidence after a task.
Resume a controlled task after compaction without loading historical noise.
